replies.author: MLGtino
replies.body:
They could at least brainstorm some ideas instead of pushing it off like their jobs are done and nothing has happened.

To offer a solution, maybe add an autobalance where a team that has 2 more players than the other team cannot be joined using ./join color. They should be assigned to the other team so it all evens out.

Just because you won't enforce some punishments doesn't mean you can't enforce any. If you kick someone for team stacking who you saw do it (and I mean you literally saw them join a team in a 3:7 ratio or something), then it will influence other members of the forums who check the infractions to say "Maybe I shouldn't do this anymore, I might get punished."
